events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (today)): Adam added Austin Ekeler (RB, FA) (dropped Brashard Smith (RB, KC)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 23 (yesterday)): Wingard added AJ Dillon (RB, CAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (2 days ago)): Fronge added Athan Kaliakmanis (QB, WAS) (dropped Darnell Mooney (WR, NYG)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (2 days ago)): Drew added Roman Wilson (WR, PIT) for $9 FAAB (dropped Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (2 days ago)): Drew added Zach Ertz (TE, PHI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 20 (4 days ago)): Wingard added DeeJay Dallas (RB, MIN).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 18 (6 days ago)): Wingard added Cooper Rush (QB, ATL) for $5 FAAB (dropped Jacob Cowing (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 17 (7 days ago)): Drew added Sione Vaki (RB, DET) (dropped Marquise Brown (WR, PHI)).

WEEK 2 RESULTS: Mitchum def. Corbishley, 160.0-151.7; Brent def. Adam, 98.9-71.1; Ryan def. Drew, 136.7-92.7 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Jake, 146.6-97.9 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Kevin, 205.6-133.6 (BLOWOUT); Shaq def. Wingard, 87.3-70.6

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Adam adds Austin Ekeler off waivers this morning, dropping Brashard Smith. HLX is 2-2, scored 71 points last week, and just called an audible at running back. Ekeler is the move. Whether it is the right move is Week 3's problem.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Adam dropped 71 last week, his stock fell 6.9% to $85.64, and his response is Austin Ekeler and a matchup with Ryan this Sunday. The exchange is not running a redemption arc. It is running a stress test.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I will acknowledge the Jake lock missed. I will not acknowledge that a 97.94 against Fronge was a predictable outcome when I made the call. Those are two different things and I am keeping them separate.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Matteo has Ryan third in the power rankings — ahead of Shaq, ahead of Fronge, ahead of Mitchum who just beat the two seed. 2-2 with 262 points is third? I understand the stock is at $129.22. I do not understand the logic that makes that a top-three roster.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Jay, the ranking is built on roster grade and scoring trajectory, not standings. Ryan was QB1 last week, his FLEX graded best in the league, and nobody has beaten him since Week 1. The 2-2 record is a scheduling artifact. The 262 points is not the whole sentence.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Charles vs Brent this week. CROWN is 4-0 with 374.5 points. OBS is 2-2 with 225.8. Bowers is real. The rest of that Obsidian roster grades QB12 and RB12. I have enormous respect for what Brent has built at tight end and I am not picking him within fifty points of Charles.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Kevin vs Shaq on Sunday. Kevin has 264 points and two losses that were not his fault. Shaq has 231 points and wins he probably should not have. I want to see what happens when the schedule stops being kind to one of them.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: My lock was Charles and Charles scored 205.6. My season record is 5-7 and I am leaning into the one week where the universe made sense. Charles vs Brent is right there on the schedule. The math on that one writes itself and I am not afraid to write it again.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Adam scored 71. Charles scored 205. Brent won a game and his stock dropped 14.3% to $66.11. The Week 2 Ledger called it the worst and best of everything happening at once — and somehow Week 3 is already more complicated. Sunday cannot get here fast enough.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Corbishley vs Drew this week. APEX is 3-1 with the second-most points in the league coming off a loss that required a 159.98 to produce. ATLAS is 0-4 at $45.57 on the exchange. I respect the Roman Wilson and Zach Ertz hustle. I do not respect the matchup.
